newsitem.title: CANADA: Poco Pete climbs on pending recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Poco Pete climbs on pending recommendation.

text.p: Shares of Poco Petroleums Ltd climbed in busy volume on Friday on a strong outlook and anticipation of a positive research report, analysts said.
Calgary-based oil and gas producer Poco was up 0.30 to 13.35 on volume of nearly 1.7 million shares.

"They've got a few good things going on on the drilling front that some people are excited about, but certainly there's nothing in the way of acquisition or corporate that's causing it," Scott Inglis, analyst with FirstEnergy Capital Corp said.
Newcrest Capital is expected to release a report on Monday that extends its "buy" recommendation for Poco and ups its one-year target price to C$16.50, a Newcrest research staffer said.
Poco, which reported strong production and financial gains for 1996, has said it expected the trend to continue this year.
Poco has projected its 1997 average production at 42,000 barrels per day of oil and gas liquids and 470 million cubic feet per day of natural gas.
The increase would be up from 1996 output of 34,194 BPD of oil and liquids and 284 MMCFD of gas.
